'''2015 MPC Frank Walsh LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Frank Walsh]] at [[2015 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Frank Walsh]]
* '''Event:''' [[2015 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
